node.html: AI methods to quantify tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes from H&E whole-slide images in triple-negative breast cancer, and to test whether the biomarker stays reliable across patient populations and imaging sources.

Models that predict EGFR mutation status in lung adenocarcinoma directly from whole-slide images, from an end-to-end pipeline built during my internship to current high-accuracy models for precision oncology.
A multi-task foundation model for joint spatial TIL quantification and adenocarcinoma / adenoma classification, aimed at precision immunotherapy.
